assumptions: Pure deterministic simulation, not production telemetry or a promise of earnings.
Actual combat rolls, legal fixed inventories, difficulty XP, level requirements and level-up refills are used. Gear/army are not upgraded automatically after leveling.
Decisions every 30s (6s in the burst case); actual Spirit and Health eligibility/recovery, defender recovery, losses, maintenance and affordable paid healing govern completed attacks.

450 shared finite bot purses; actual saved portfolio rates and real-cost upkeep/reserves; no Vault withdrawals or extra endowments. Humans start with 5,000 after equipment and one paid upkeep hour; no human Land income or quests.
Player order is deterministic and serial, demonstrating contention, not CPU-thread fairness. Real concurrent transaction safety is tested separately in PostgreSQL.
Human skill allocations are budget-checked; unused points are not spent. No recruitment, banking, new Land, equipment purchases or strategy learning occurs during these scenarios.
